title: Titanium-based hydrides as heterogeneous catalysts for ammonia synthesis
extraction_notes: The provided Supporting Information contains no experimental NH3 synthesis catalyst-performance entries. SI Table S1 and SI Figure S1 are crystallographic/Rietveld characterization of BaTiO2.5H0.5 before/after reaction and are out of scope. SI Figures S2–S3 and associated text are DFT/model-surface adsorption calculations and are out of scope.
